title: 経営情報専門実験・演習B
subtitle: Management Systems Major Lab/Exercises B
keywords: Strategy Planning 2.Costs, Sales, & Profit 3.Business Game 4.Profit Planning 5.Programming for Embedded Systems
educationalGoal: This practicum in applied business management is a compulsory course for third-year students. In this course, students will: (1) Use the case method to develop the analytical and planning skills needed to formulate a business strategy. (2) Participate in a business game intended to develop the analytical and planning skills needed to make a profit. (3) Implement their ideas and exercise their programming skills using Arduino.
advice: This compulsory course uses the following: 1) the YBG Bakery Game, a competitive business game accessible on the Internet, which serves as a review of the relationship between sales volume, costs and profit, and profit planning. (group activity) Students will be required to create documents such as financial reports, business operation reports, market mechanism reports, and game review reports. 2) Strategy planning in which students will review and analyze the strategies of ‘real’ companies and develop new strategies for these companies. (group activity) Students will be required to create documents such as a strategic analysis report and devise a new strategic plan. 3) Programming for an original system using Arduino. (individual activity) Students will be required to implement their ideas via Arduino and give a presentation describing the implementation.
books: Make:Getting Started with Arduino 4th Edition(Publisher:Make Community)
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of management Basic computer skills

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the operations of the business game used in the course.

Be able to engage in effective profit planning.
Be able to create simple financial statements.
Be able to engage in effective strategy planning in a business framework.
Be able to create a program using Arduino.

achievementLevels.standard: 1) Review and analyze the strategy of a ‘real’ company based on news releases, and formulate a strategy for the company. 2) Develop a profit plan and implement operations in the business game. 3) Create a programming work using Arduino.
